newsitem.title: USA: Mass. trade mission to tour Israel, Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Mass. trade mission to tour Israel, Ireland.

text.p: Massachusetts Gov. William Weld will lead a delegation from nearly 40 companies to Israel, Ireland and Northern Ireland in late February and early March to promote trade.
Representatives from many high-technology and biotechnology companies are included in the trade junket, such as International Business Machines Corp, Biogen Inc and Raytheon Co.
"These (Israel and Ireland) may be our two favorite destinations for trade missions, but they are also well justified on a business basis," Weld told a press conference at Boston's fish pier.

The Republican governor said that Israel ranks as one of the top 20 destinations for Massachusetts products and Ireland's strong software manufacturers have connections with Massachusetts companies. Weld opened a Massachusetts trade office in Jerusalem in 1992.

"I think what we're finding is enormous synergies in technology," between the New England states and the two nations, said Dana Edelman, executive director of the New England/Israel Chamber of Commerce.
The delegation will depart on Feb. 28 for Isreal, and then go to Ireland and Northern Ireland on March 3 before returning to Massachusetts on March 8.
